title: Canonical open base-change components respect the open unit
statement: Fix derived categories of modules for all schemes [def-pc-derived-category], q:X′→X [def-pc-scheme], K∈D(O_X), K′∈D(O_X′), and ψ:Lq* K→K′ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For U⊆X, put U′=q⁻¹U, q_U:U′→U and use the canonical exact-open adjunctions A_U,A_U′ and pullback/restriction comparison b_U:Lq*;r_U′≅r_U;Lq_U* of [def-pc-rf-mv-base-change-components, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. Let β_U be BC(j_U,j_U′,q,q_U) at r_U K [def-pc-derived-base-change-map], followed by Rj_U′* of b_U inverse at K followed by r_U′(ψ) [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Then Lq*(η_U(K));β_U=ψ;η_U′(K′). No covering, compactness or quasi-coherence hypothesis is needed.

source.place: Tags 08HY and 08BV; perfect.tex Tag 0DJ9 induction step; Tag 0D5S for the specified composition comparisons

proof.text: For arbitrary adjunctions L⊣R and L′⊣R′, functors P,Q, and an isomorphism e:P;L′≅L;Q, define the mate at Y by β_Y=homEquiv′(e_RY;Q(ε_Y)). Naturality of homEquiv and e, followed by naturality of ε, proves P(R(k));β_Z=β_Y;R′(Q(k)). This is the private mate_naturality calculation.

Transpose P(η_K);β_LK;R′(e_K inverse;L′(ψ)) under L′⊣R′. Naturality of e moves P(η_K) through e, the triangle identity L(η_K);ε_LK=id cancels the middle pair, and e_K;e_K inverse=id cancels the comparison. The transpose is L′(ψ), whose mate is ψ;η′_K′. This is private mate_unit.

Transport the preceding identity to the exact-open adjunctions using d=leftAdjointUniq and d′=leftAdjointUniq. Their unit equations identify η_exact with η_pullback;R(d). Mate naturality moves d through β. For b=P(d′ inverse);e;Q(d), the identity Q(d);b inverse=e inverse;d′ cancels d with its inverse. Naturality of d′ and its unit equation identify the final unit. This proves mate_unit_transport.

Instantiate e by c(j′,q);eqToIso(resLE_comp_ι inverse);c(q|U,j) inverse, using the exact same selected canonical pullback comparisons and canonical adjunctions as schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap. The definition of mvPullbackOpenRestrictionIso is P(d′ inverse);e;Q(d). Expanding only those composites gives mvOpenBaseChange_unit. No associativity coherence for triple pullbacks is used.

lean.statement:
theorem mvOpenBaseChange_unit
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (q : X' ⟶ X)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (ψ : (derivedPullback q).obj K ⟶ K') (U : X.Opens) :
    (derivedPullback q).map ((mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X U).unit.app K) ≫
        schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap U.ι (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι q
          (q.resLE U (q ⁻¹ᵁ U) le_rfl) (Scheme.Hom.resLE_comp_ι q le_rfl)
          ((schemeOpenRestriction X U).mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (q ⁻¹ᵁ U).ι).map
          ((mvPullbackOpenRestrictionIso q U).inv.app K ≫
            (schemeOpenRestriction X' (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).mapDerivedCategory.map ψ) =
      ψ ≫ (mvOpenRestrictionAdjunction X' (q ⁻¹ᵁ U)).unit.app K'
